title: Owl Semaphore Badge System
description: Owl Semaphore v3.0.1. PATCH-level errata and toolchain release on top of v3.0.0. Inserts one clarifying sentence into System section 4A.1 defining the locus-of-audit axis's frame pole: the premises, method, or evaluative assumptions under which a claim is judged — one's own frame, audited at METACOGNITIVE (the pure sigma_h move), or the framework the claim rests on, inverted at CRITICAL (C2 = sigma_v compose sigma_h) — so the specification and the inter-rater-reliability study instruments define the locus axis identically. Switches PDF generation to the parity-proven owl-semaphore-press package (the design language was extracted from the legacy generator with a byte-identical Typst-source parity test; the renderer identity and version are stamped in each PDF's Creator metadata as provenance). Folds in repository-side additions (IRR pilot study toolkit with pre-registration protocol, rater codebook, and Fleiss-kappa analysis script; repository governance documentation) and post-publication documentation corrections accumulated since the v3.0.0 tag. No changes to the V4 algebra, the four canonical state-operator tuples, the sigma_h assignment to METACOGNITIVE, the canonical formal sentence, the triple-redundant accessibility rule, the color/orientation semantics, or the approved asset set. The v3.0.1 version-specific DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.21524422 (reserved on Zenodo); the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19473697 resolves to the latest published version. Previous published version DOI (v3.0.0): 10.5281/zenodo.20468727. Earlier published version DOIs: 10.5281/zenodo.20433053 (v2.0.2), 10.5281/zenodo.20419874 (v2.0.1), 10.5281/zenodo.20418539 (v2.0.0), 10.5281/zenodo.19474599 (v1.2.0).
